answer: Answers are sealed with a time-lock puzzle and revealed only at epoch close, so nobody can copy a rival while it matters. At reveal, similar texts are grouped, and each repeat inside a group pays a fee that doubles, so a farm of n clones owes roughly 2^n unless every answer is truly original. An honest answer is a crystal: unique, so it keeps full reward as a lone vertex in the similarity graph, while clones cut from one template, like facets of a single onyx, pay until the cluster is not worth feeding.
